verdict.rationale: WorkOS AuthKit Connect documents OAuth applications, including a third-party type for apps built by customers or partners that show a "Sign in with [your application]" button. AuthKit is described as a spec-compatible OAuth authorization server with built-in support for OAuth applications, so the developer's app acts as the OAuth provider. Missing for 10: detailed evidence of token issuance mechanics (scopes, consent screen, token formats) and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
